newsitem.title: USA: Murphy Oil sees good margins, more product.
newsitem.headline: Murphy Oil sees good margins, more product.

text.p: Murphy Oil Corp said Friday that margins are good at all three refineries, plant utilization rates remain high, with production increasing and costs are under control.

Murphy said it projects natural gas production in the U.S. for 1997 to average about 215 million cubic feet a day, up from 155 million in 1996 and estimates average worldwide oil production at about 57,000 barrels a day, up from 53,000.
Murphy said it continues to seek acquisition of frontier acreage.
Although recent bidding efforts in Venezuela were unsuccessful, the company is aggressively working additional opportunities in Latin America and Southeast Asia, it said.
